articles.title: Larkin Associates Begins Leasing Phase II of 420-Unit Multifamily Development in Forks Township, Pennsylvania
articles.summary: FORKS TOWNSHIP, PA. — New Jersey-based owner-operator Larkin Associates has begun leasing Phase II of Trailside Village, a 420-unit multifamily development located in the Lehigh Valley community of Forks Township. Trailside Village is a 22-building apartment community with one- and two-bedroom units that also features 27,000 square feet of commercial space that can support retail, office and healthcare uses. articles.title: Joint Venture Buys 78-Unit Seniors Housing Complex in Metro Philadelphia
articles.summary: PAOLI, PA. — A joint venture between Senior Living Transformation Co. and Sabal Investment Holdings has purchased Daylesford Crossing, a 78-unit seniors housing complex located in the western Philadelphia suburb of Paoli. Opened in 2015, Daylesford Crossing offers assisted living and memory care services and amenities such as a media room, wellness room, library and a salon, as well as an onsite healthcare facility. articles.title: Benchmark, Regal Ventures Buy 85,053 SF Industrial Building in Easton, Pennsylvania
articles.summary: EASTON, PA. — A partnership between Pennsylvania-based developer Benchmark Real Estate and New York City-based investment firm Regal Ventures has purchased an 85,053-square-foot industrial building in Easton, located in the Lehigh Valley. Constructed on 12.4 acres in 1972, the building at 100 Kuebler Road is located within Forks Industrial Park and houses the global headquarters of Human Active Technology (HAT), a designer and manufacturer of ergonomic workspace solutions. articles.title: Reading’s Big Mill Apartments sold

articles.title: Elk guides cited with trespassing on potential Pa.-record bull hunt
articles.summary: Two guides who helped harvest a potential Pennsylvania record elk in Centre County are facing trespassing charges after a landowner complaint, though the hunter has not been cited.

articles.title: Renovations planned at Selinsgrove swimming pool
articles.summary: SELINSGROVE — Selinsgrove Area Recreation Inc. (SARI) is applying for nearly $300,000 in grants to pave the parking lot and make repairs at the community swimming pool facility.

articles.title: Dart Container expands packaging capacity at Lancaster facility
articles.summary: Dart Container has expanded its molded fiber packaging capacity at its Lancaster facility to meet demand for renewable, compostable food packaging. The post Dart Container expands packaging capacity at Lancaster facility appeared first on Central Penn Business Journal .

articles.title: Fulton Bank launches banking program for minority and veteran business owners

articles.title: Tyson Foods launches ride sharing program at its Lancaster County complex
articles.summary: Tyson Foods, just outside New Holland in Earl Township, has launched a ride-share program to address transportation barriers among current workers and attract prospective ones through a partnership with Enterprise, a car rental company.

articles.title: 'It's really all I wanted to do': workers at former R.R. Donnelley plants mourn closure
